title: The A-Team
description:

Guerrilla terrorists capture an Army general and his daughter. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team rescues Amy's college chum from being forced to marry a tycoon who may have killed her father.

title: The A-Team
description:

Hannibal poses as an airline executive to get aboard a jumbo jet hijacked by terrorists; guest Andy Robinson.

title: The A-Team
description:

While attending a friend's funeral, the A-Team encounters a crazed mountain clan. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E8 — Alice in Disco Land
In a disco, Banner learns a dancer (Donna Wilkes) is being exploited.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E7 — Another Path
A Chinese philosopher's nerve-control techniques may help Banner; guest Mako.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E14 — Like a Brother
Banner gets caught between a dope dealer and a crusading preacher; guests Carl Anderson, Ernie Hudson.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E13 — A Solitary Place
A beautiful fugitive (Kathryn Leigh Scott) interrupts Banner's wilderness retreat.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 — Deadly Knightshade
Michael and KITT chase an elusive magician (Lance Burton) who may be after Devon; with Hurd Hatfield.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E16 — Redemption of a Champion
A deaf sportswriter is murdered after calling Devon with his concerns over the welfare of a contender in an upcoming prizefight.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 — Knight of a Thousand Devils
Michael enters an off-road race to catch a mobster planning an illegal border crossing; guest Henry Darrow.

title: Emergency!
description:

Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E18 — Seance
A woman believes her dead sister is the cause of accidents in her home; a man is trapped underwater in his car with the doors jammed.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E19 — Boot
Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.

title: Emergency!
description:

The paramedics conduct several rescues under a shadow of guilt after being accused of stealing from a patient; guest Jo Anne Worley.
